meta.description: Payment release contract. A payment row is READY only if it passes every expectation; any failure HOLDS it with the expectation's hold_reason.

inputs.payments: payments_sep_nov_2026.csv (client_id joined from the email export via email_id)
inputs.accounts_on_file: Client Settlement Accounts on File.xlsx, sheet 'Accounts On File'

meta.normalisation: Account numbers are compared as text with all whitespace removed (IBAN grouping spaces). They are never converted to numbers, so leading zeros are kept. No other characters are altered.

meta.hold_reason: client ID not in accounts file
account differs from account on file
currency differs from client's account currency
